name: web-members-grid-with-square-photos-role-labels-and-invite-button
title: Members panel with a grey header, search icon and black Invite Members button above a grid of rounded square portraits with names and roles
whatItIs: A white page with a light grey header bar showing 'Members' and 'Team Avengers • 10 Members' with a small search button and a black 'Invite Members' button, and a grid of five rounded-square portrait photos each captioned with a name and a grey role (Admin, Editor, Viewer).
whatItMeans: Personal and orderly; large faces make a member list feel human.
techniques: Show members as large rounded photos.
Add a header with count and actions.

vocabulary.definition: A grid of member photos with captions.
A grey caption such as Admin or Viewer.
A bar with title, count and actions.
